mapper.sql: id, job_no AS jobNo, status, file_name AS fileName, file_path AS filePath, total_rows AS totalRows, processed_rows AS processedRows, succeeded_rows AS succeededRows, skipped_rows AS skippedRows, error_report_path AS errorReportPath, error_summary AS errorSummary, version, attempt_count AS attemptCount, started_at AS startedAt, last_heartbeat_at AS lastHeartbeatAt, lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, expired_at AS expiredAt, error_code AS errorCode, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt

UPDATE import_jobs SET status = 'RUNNING', processed_rows = 0, succeeded_rows = 0, skipped_rows = 0, error_report_path = NULL, error_summary = NULL, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = #{now}, last_heartbeat_at = #{now}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}
UPDATE import_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE import_jobs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = #{now}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE import_jobs SET status = 'PARTIAL', error_report_path = #{errorReportPath}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, finished_at = #{now}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE import_jobs SET status = 'PENDING', processed_rows = 0, succeeded_rows = 0, skipped_rows = 0, error_report_path = NULL, error_summary = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, expired_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, last_heartbeat_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'FAILED' AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}

UPDATE import_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{now}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_expires_at = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now})
